derivation.note: No simulation was re-run. Every v4 metric was recomputed from the preserved event ledger and terminal snapshot of the source trials. The v3 run reports were not rescored or edited.

accepted_prior_trial.deviation: static_context_mechanics_text: ore was described as a 'high-value raw material' rather than as smeltable into an ingot. One line of a 6,430-character static context.
accepted_prior_trial.audited: The other two differences introduced with v4 were checked against these ledgers and do not bind. No structure in any run had more than one contributor, so the construction contributor-share change is inert. Engine-declared trade values never reached agents: market history was already filtered to give/receive bundles and event rendering never exposed event data. Trial settings, horizon, integrity, and usage coverage all match v4 exactly.

result_tier.policy: Both required seeds completed 50 ticks with clean integrity and full usage coverage. The trials predate v4, so certification carries an audited declared deviation rather than being silent.
